code:
1. Open a PR; show CI green (lint, test, Trivy,
   Checkov, gitleaks).
2. Merge to main -> auto-deploy to northbridge-dev.
3. Cut a tag -> auto-deploy to staging, then the
   manual approval gate for prod.
4. Approve; show the prod deploy complete.
5. Open the checkout Grafana dashboard + SLO panel.
6. Replay 60s of the flash-sale drill; show the new
   saturation alert fire, with a runbook link.
7. Close on the postmortem and its action items.
